authentication.title: 1. Authentication & Registration APIs

apis.description: Verify email address with token sent via email
Request SMS OTP for phone verification
Upload KYC identity documents with AI OCR processing

Auto-approve if OCR confidence > 85% and data matches
Route to manual review queue if confidence < 85%

projects.title: 2. Project Management APIs
projects.description: Client project submission, AI analysis, and project lifecycle management

notes: After creation, trigger AI analysis asynchronously
Status flows: draft -> pending_analysis -> pending_approval -> active -> completed

apis.description: List projects with filters and pagination
Publish project to make it available for team assignment

apis.description: Trigger AI analysis for project (internal or manual trigger)
notes: This should normally be called automatically after project creation
AI should analyze: requirements complexity, recommended tech stack, team size, cost estimation
Store results in ai_analysis table linked to project

apis.description: Get AI analysis results for project

tasks.title: 3. Task Management APIs

apis.description: Developer accepts task from task hall
notes: Check developer qualifications (verified, deposit paid)
Change task status from 'open' to 'assigned' and set assigned_to
Change task status back to 'open'
Change task status to 'in_review'
Notify architect and reviewers

apis.description: Architect or Reviewer reviews code submission
notes: If approved: mark task as 'completed', trigger payment
If needs_revision: change task status back to 'in_progress'
If rejected: may need arbitration flow

payments.title: 4. Payment & Wallet APIs
payments.description: Deposit payment, milestone payments, bonuses, refunds, and wallet management

notes: For deposit payments, integrate with third-party payment gateway (Alipay/WeChat Pay/Stripe)
Return payment gateway URL for redirect
Implement webhook to receive payment confirmation
Integrate with payment gateway to process refund
Update wallet balance
Update payment status to 'refunded'

users.title: 5. User Management APIs

roles.title: 6. Role Management APIs

apis.description: Check if developer is eligible for architect promotion

notes: After successful payment, update user role to 'architect'
Grant architect permissions

apis.description: Check if user can apply as reviewer
Apply for reviewer role and start qualification test
notes: Select 3 random completed anonymous code snippets from database
Ensure these snippets already have verified final scores from actual reviewers
Compare applicant ratings with actual final scores
Pass threshold: 85% similarity
If failed, user can retry after 7 days

security: Implement CORS policies for frontend domains
Use Laravel Sanctum or Passport for API authentication
Encrypt sensitive data (KYC documents, payment info)
Implement rate limiting on all API endpoints
Use HTTPS only for all communications
Validate and sanitize all user inputs
Implement CSRF protection for state-changing operations
performance: Use database indexing on foreign keys and frequently queried columns
Implement caching for frequently accessed data (Redis/Memcached)
Use queue workers for heavy tasks (AI analysis, OCR processing, email sending)
Use eager loading to avoid N+1 queries

apiTesting: Use Postman or Insomnia to test all endpoints
Test authentication flows with valid/invalid tokens
Test file upload size limits and type validation
Test concurrent requests and race conditions
